newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau inflation five percent Jan-Sept year-on-year.
newsitem.headline: Macau inflation five percent Jan-Sept year-on-year.

text.p: Macau's year-on-year inflation rate stood at five percent in the first nine months of 1996 as measured by the composite consumer price index (CCPI), the Statistics and Census Department said on Friday.
Inflation was 3.9 percent comparing September 1996 to September last year. Month-on-month, consumer prices rose one percent in September on August 1996.
The CCPI averages the expenditure patterns of various income groups in the Portuguese-administered enclave, but excludes housing rents. -- Hong Kong newsroom (852) 2843 6441
